title: CORAVEL a new tool for radial velocity measurements
what_was_studied: Physical-mask cross-correlation and photoelectric velocity measurement
numerical_result: The design converted a scanned correlation dip into a stellar radial velocity rather than recording a modern CCD echelle spectrum
remaining_question: How should CORAVEL zero points be transferred into later digital catalogues?

title: First observations with CORAVEL at La Silla
what_was_studied: La Silla implementation on the Danish 1.54 m telescope
numerical_result: The report describes a 5 Hz scan and typical single-measurement accuracy near 0.5 km/s
remaining_question: How stable was the velocity zero point across masks and observing seasons?

title: Accurate radial velocities thanks to CORAVEL
what_was_studied: Cluster stellar velocities from the La Silla instrument
numerical_result: Mean per-measurement accuracies of 0.6 and 0.9 km/s were reported for the 47 Tuc and omega Centauri programmes
remaining_question: Selection and crowding effects need the original target-level records

title: La Silla decommissioned instruments
numerical_result: ESO lists CORAVEL at the Danish 1.54 m among decommissioned instruments
remaining_question: The official list does not state an exact retirement date
